title: 15 heads in 20 tosses of a fair coin
caption: Under H₀ the number of heads is B(20, 0.5). P(X ≥ 15) = 0.0207, below 5%, so 15 heads is unusual enough to reject fairness.
alt: Bar chart of B(20, 0.5) with bars 15 to 20 shaded, total 0.0207.
description: Under H₀ the count is B(20, 0.5), centred at 10.
The shaded bars from 15 up add to 0.0207.
That is below 0.05, so reject H₀.
